text.p: Following are the main stories in Thursday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Malaysian ambassador to Peru Ahmad Mokhtar Selat returned home on Wednesday after spending 12 days captive to Peruvian Marxist rebels in Lima, Peru.

- Maju Holdings Sdn Bhd has been given a 51 percent stake in the ailing steel maker Perwaja Steel Sdn Bhd, sealing the rescue of the company. In addition to the stake, Maju will also be managing the company.

- The government will "take over" the losses totalling 2.8 billion ringgit, of Perwaja Steel Sdn Bhd. Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said on Wednesday, however, this did not mean the government would pump money into the company.

- An incident in which a Malaysian student in Australia was reportedly (racially) abused will not damage the country's relations with Australia, said Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad in a letter to Victoria state leader Jeff Kennet.
